editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a professional prankster finally meets someone who is just as crazy as they are? You get this wild ride of a movie. The story follows a guy who loves messing with people, but his life changes when he crosses paths with Tahir Yaman. Instead of backing down, Tahir fights back with his own tricks. The whole vibe is like a game of cat and mouse where the roles keep switching. It is a lighthearted battle of wits that quickly turns into a chaotic loop of revenge, making you wonder who will actually win the prank war first.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the two leads and the fast pacing that keeps you guessing. While some of the jokes might feel a bit silly, the energy stays high throughout the film. If you enjoy movies where simple arguments turn into huge disasters, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final act, the constant cycle of pranks reaches a breaking point where both characters realize they are more alike than they thought. After a series of huge mishaps that almost ruin their lives, they stop fighting and decide to call a truce. The movie wraps up with them forming an unlikely friendship, proving that the only person who can truly understand a prankster is another prankster. They end the film laughing together at their own chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and prank wars.
